description: Introducing the OPPO K14x 5G smartphone in a stunning Prism Violet finish, designed to keep you connected and powered throughout the day. Equipped with a massive 6500mAh long-lasting battery, this smartphone ensures you never run out of charge during your busiest moments. When it does need a top-up, the 45W fast charging capability gets you back up and running in no time. The device comes with 4GB RAM and 64GB storage, offering smooth multitasking and ample space for your apps, photos, and media. The eye-catching geometric pattern on the rear panel adds a premium touch to its overall design, while the sleek, slim profile makes it comfortable to hold. Featuring 5G connectivity, the OPPO K14x keeps you ahead of the curve with blazing-fast network speeds. The large, immersive display with a punch-hole front camera delivers vibrant visuals for streaming, gaming, and browsing. Whether you are a student, a professional, or a casual user, the OPPO K14x 5G is a reliable companion that blends style with performance seamlessly.
